binary_identity.first_report_rejection: Passing byte comparisons were followed by test-only double destruction of a Context-owned shader module; corrected clean-exit rerun accepted instead.

preserving_byte_proof.scope: Bounded existing8frameSDRcitysequence; currentDirect versus finalalpha2Shared candidate replay, sameinputs andhistories; not broadmotionqualification

limitations: Network timestamps exclude D3D12 bridge, FSR and presentation; no game FPS is inferred.
Profile instrumentation timings are kept separate from ordinary benchmark timings.
Performance eligibility alone does not qualify arithmetic, temporal behavior or release readiness.
Bundled offline LLPC differs from installed Windows driver pipelines.
Static instruction counts are code counts; loops and runtime execution frequencies are not included.
Distinct public amd_gemm_direct variant includes uniform row-overdispatch guard; GPU qualifications and ordinary timings are collected separately.
Prototype screening is shorter than the required final ordinary interleaved timing protocol.
The measured alpha3 game still misses the NR-plus-bridge and 60 FPS targets; broad scene/temporal review, highlight acceptance and active gameplay remain incomplete.
Static offline instruction counts do not represent executed instruction frequency or installed-driver performance.
Old Q64-to-Q32 attention and alpha2 game results retain their original identities.
NVIDIA DLLs, extracted weights and game captures remain excluded.
New game runtime brackets are asynchronous completed-row publication intervals without an exact per-present join; sampled VRAM maxima are not true interval peaks.

source_package_rebuild.scope: Bounded SHA256 comparison of existing source-build SPIR-V and neural core/runtime/shader sources; auxiliary build/test differences are recorded separately.

source_identity.scope: Candidate built from dirty base; frozen source identity and measured binary hashes identify this evidence. A later release commit must not substitute a different measured binary.
